description:
Job Functions / Responsibilities: 
 Work in a variety of frameworks including Ruby on Rails, .net and others.
 To design and develop websites ensuring strong optimization and functionality.
 Work on projects including web layout, enhancements, desktop applications, web based applications. 
 Code web sites utilizing CSS and HMTL and programming languages.
 Manage relationships with clients.
 Work with cross-functional teams as and when required.
 Maintain excellent customer satisfaction level.
 Other duties as assigned.
 Skills Required:
 Basic Knowledge of web developement fundamentals.
 Introductory knowledge of Python/ Ruby on Rails/ HTML5/ CSS3.
 Elementary knowledge on basic DBMS Concepts.
 Knowledge of OOPs (Object Oriented Programming) Concepts.
 Knowledge of My SQL, Oracle and Database.
 Prompt, responsive, responsible and friendly approach to customer situations.
 Other Skills / Abilities: 

 Good communication skills.
 Eager to learn new things.
 Ability to balance multiple priorities.
 Ability to handle difficult situations.
 Hard working smart individual.
 Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
 Excellent attitude and spirit of cooperation.
 Strong interpersonal and communications skills.
 Professional telephone etiquette's.
 Internet friendly.
 
 Bachelors or Masters Degree in Computer Science or Information Technology or a related field (such as BE, BTech, MTech, BCA, MCA, BSc IT, MSc IT)
